title: Deep learning identifies cardiac coupling between mother and fetus during gestation.
summary: Two-block CNN classified maternal-fetal coupling from 1-minute ECG segments; 721 training, 152 local-test and 68 PhysioNet external-test segments, with 90.1% local and 89.7% external accuracy.
